config.study: Measured non-unit CPU cost dimensions and runtime allocation restrictions
config.dimension_criterion: Independent nominal calibration interval must exclude one for a non-unit-cost example; no pure-power fit to abundance is a primary endpoint
config.primary_endpoint: Actual per-thread user+system CPU resource shares by the fixed size classes, including completed jobs, censored partial jobs and loop overhead
config.secondary_endpoint: Complete count shares from independent full CPU-cost calibration, conditioned on observed total completed jobs; pure-degree approximation and unit-degree alternative separately compared
config.allocation_hypothesis: Continuously runnable pure-Python threads receive equal CPU time under the unmodified CPython GIL/OS mechanism; class CPU share proportional to declared thread count
competing_hypotheses: equal job service per runnable thread
equal CPU resource per active class
unit cost degree with equal runnable-thread CPU
config.restriction: Replace the largest-size thread with a second smallest-size thread, keeping total runnable count five
config.measurement_scope: Single process, five workload threads plus an ordinarily blocked controller; no per-class CPU quotas, manual job targets, priority or affinity changes, or switch-interval changes
config.uncertainty_scope: Nominal block resampling for calibration dimension; all four actual allocation trials retained; frozen profile tolerances are exploratory engineering criteria without a claimed population false-positive rate

natural_dataset_candidate.finding: Primary metadata supplies cell volume, carbon per cell, counts and Si:N/grazing treatments. It does not directly supply per-cell nitrogen/silica requirements needed to predict a nutrient-budget intervention without further physiological assumptions. No natural outcome data were downloaded or analyzed for this study.

quadratic.uncertainty: Nominal percentile resampling of 12 randomized calibration blocks; hardware drift and correlated blocks are not covered

cubic.uncertainty: Nominal percentile resampling of 12 randomized calibration blocks; hardware drift and correlated blocks are not covered

execution_context_disclosure.basis: Root agent reported confirmed concurrent development-benchmark collection after this allocation window ended.
execution_context_disclosure.known_concurrent_activity: Another research agent collected development-stage numerical simulations during the allocation window; its final evaluation stage had not started.
execution_context_disclosure.interpretation: Concurrent activity can affect processor frequency, thermal conditions and cost transfer. Per-thread CPU accounting remains measured; no quiet-machine or background-load isolation claim is made.
